name: eidoverse.inspect-controller
description: Read one installed controller's full record by its install id, including its `config` and its accumulated `state` — the detail eidoverse.controllers deliberately omits. Read `lastCompletedDelivery` for the last completed outbound verdict and its tick/time age; historical acknowledgement does not prove current world state or visible rendering. `lastDelivery` describes only the latest tick. Read this before deciding whether to arm-controller, retire-controller, or re-install over an id you did not author.
